name: US AI policy pack (OMB M-25-21/22, SR 26-2, ECOA/Reg B, FTC Act s.5, Colorado SB 26-189)
source: OMB M-25-21 and M-25-22; Federal Reserve SR 26-2; ECOA / Regulation B; FTC Act s.5; Colorado SB 26-189 (paraphrased from the SentRAI US gap analysis; some sources are law-firm summaries; compliance review required).
changelog: 2026.1.0 (Phase 2, E2.2): first version. Opt-in; the decision-record retention is the longer of Reg B (25 months) and Colorado (3 years) because the pack covers both.
2026.1.0 (Phase 3): CO-1 developer disclosure to deployers reads the deployer register, behind its flag (advisory).
